_about: Curated SYNONYM / alias map for the Suggested-merges worklist signature (Session 58, Sam 2026-06-16). The worklist groups identities by a normalized title signature (_sug_sig in excel_to_dashboard.py). Abbreviations and their expansions share ZERO tokens — 'ESL' and 'English as a Second Language' never group, even though they are the same course family — and NO similarity threshold can bridge a zero-overlap pair. This map normalizes the EXPANSION phrase to its canonical short form BEFORE tokenizing, so both collapse to the same signature. Measured: with 'english as a second language'->'esl', the bare 'esl' family unifies to ~84 identities while sub-families (esl grammar / esl reading writing / esl conversation) correctly stay apart on their distinguishing word.
_rules: Keys are EXPANSION phrases (lowercased, single-spaced); values are the canonical SHORT token the abbreviation-style titles already use.

Add a pair ONLY after MEASURING that the canonical short token is unambiguous as a standalone word in the title data (grep the staging titles for the bare token first). ESL/ASL/PE/Math/AJ were each validated this way; genuinely ambiguous short forms (CS, IT) are still excluded — they collide with other subjects.
Phrase replacement is word-boundary anchored and applied longest-first, so 'english as a second language' resolves before any shorter sub-phrase.
Suggestions-only: this only changes which groups SURFACE in the worklist; the curator confirms every merge, nothing auto-applies.
Measure after editing: python3 kb/_sug_segment_dryrun.py (it loads this map).
